The '''''Redstar''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]].

==History==
In [[44 ABY]], the ''Redstar'' dropped [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] off at the entrance to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]] for their mission to [[Abeloth's planet]]. After the mission, Luke regained consciousness in a medbay over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aboard a large vessel, which he thought was most likely the ''Redstar''.
